subject: mathematics
content: Let P be an arbitrary point having sum of the squares of the distances from the planes x + y + z = 0, lx $$-$$ nz = 0 and x $$-$$ 2y + z = 0, equal to 9. If the locus of the point P is x<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>2</sup> + z<sup>2</sup> = 9, then the value of l $$-$$ n is equal to _________.
